{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print("Data types:")
print(sales.dtypes)

print("\nFirst few rows:")
print(sales.head())

print("\nUnique values in status:")
print(sales['status'].unique())

print("\nUnique values in revenue:")
print(sales['revenue'].unique())

print("\nCount of revenue == '999999.99':")
print(sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99'].shape[0])

print("\nCount of status == 'completed':")
print(sales[sales['status'] == 'completed'].shape[0])

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print("\nCount of customer_age == -1:")
print(sales[sales['customer_age'] == -1].shape[0])"}
